claim_boundary: design only: readiness from source, prefab and generator evidence; no engine ran, no outcome was read, no model was trained or scored. Runtime readiness is decided by the smoke gate. Prior dispositions (#15-#112) are read-only inputs

bird_zone_push.region: 4 x 3 trigger box; the law uses the left half only
bird_zone_push.rule: force = -transform.right * 25 on the launched bird while 0 < fan.x - bird.x < 2 and |bird.y - fan.y| < 1.5

event_wind.rule: after the first bird is destroyed: force = (3, 0) on flying or dying birds and on blocks whose speed exceeds 0.1; a grey sprite (35.8 x 19.2 world units, alpha 0.5) is instantiated at onset, so the storm becomes visible only then

global_gravity.rule: Physics2D.gravity = (0, 6); birds not on the slingshot at load get gravityScale -1

radial_linear.rule: force = 15 * (magnet - body) on birds and on blocks of another material, the reverse on blocks of the magnet's material, inside radius 4; a body that collides with the magnet leaves the force lists until it re-enters the field

region_push.region: box of 0.64 * (scaleX, scaleY) world units centred on the authored position
region_push.rule: force = transform.up * turbulenceForce on every body inside the trigger box whose speed exceeds 0.1; pigs and platforms excluded

task_objective.decision_cost_unit: single pig per level (all 80 templates author exactly one pig)
task_objective.every_level: first-shot success = engine pig removal (the #85 channel's pig_removed); decision cost = the #99 tie-free cost on pig:0000 (presence - 0.1 * displacement), lower is better; terminal kinds native_clear / native_fail / stable_without_clear / right_censored
task_objective.level_7: unchanged. The changed goal is the air-turbulence agent's: InverseAirTurbulence pushes down (turbulenceForce -10) where NonNovelAirTurbulence pushes up (+1.5). The engine clear condition (every pig dead) and fail condition (birds exhausted) do not change

engine_sources.designer_player_note: sciencebirdsgames/physics-v2 (built from tasks/task_template_designer) drops <Novelty> nodes in LevelLoader; it is not the capture player and is not used
engine_sources.recovered_source: original NovPhy player (sciencebirdsgames/Linux) recovered with AssetRipper 2.0.0; decompiled behaviour checked against IL in docs/issue-76-canonical-migration-progress.md

script_literals.pins: fan acts on the launched bird only
bird death >= 3 s after its first collision

campaign_dependencies: #113 capture-window spec merged before launch (storm onset needs the first bird destroyed, >= 3 s after its first collision; level 6 and 8 are window-sensitive)
one joint #104 + #110 freeze on the issue-109 pipeline (scripts/capture_pipeline_v2.py)
dispatch order ordinal-major: every pair at ordinal k before any pair at k + 1, so a stopped campaign keeps balanced cells

encoder.architecture: the #99 SpatialSlotParser (E99) with one query per v2 slot (28) and the v2 kind vocabulary; carrier = v1 header + 4 scene fields + 13 features x 28 slots
encoder.arms: one encoder per condition shared by the hybrid and continuous predictor families (identical budgets)
encoder.presence_target: lifecycle active and body present, except the novelty slot: present when its source has a renderer (Fan, air turbulence, Magnet, Pink*); InverseGravity/Storm never present
encoder.scene_head_input: carriers of the last k = 15 agent frames, the #113 temporal-head interface

scene_targets.storm_active: storm_onset_step <= step (first bird entity destroyed) on level 8

approximations.event_wind: flying-or-dying bird approximated by 'launched and still active'
approximations.radial_linear: trigger overlap approximated by centre distance < radius; 'removed after a collision until re-entry' approximated by 'not in contact with the magnet at this step'
approximations.region_push: trigger overlap approximated by the body centre lying inside the box

force_predicates.per_delta_rule: a predicate requested at Delta is true when it holds at any frame in (t, t + Delta]; the #113 settle / structure-change redefinitions apply unchanged

identifiability.ceiling: the same probe on engine features (positions and velocities of every slot)
identifiability.consequence: a non-identifiable force keeps its cell captured and its rollout error reported; claims about reading that force are withheld
identifiability.inputs: v2 carriers of the last k agent frames plus 1-frame differences; k in (1, 5, 15), primary 15
identifiability.probe: MLP (hidden 64), class-balanced BCE, 2000 updates, lr 1e-3, seed 1100001
identifiability.question: is the force state at t recoverable from the permitted observations up to t?
identifiability.rationale: #113 exploratory probes: a recoverable predicate (steady-state) reached 0.81-0.92, an unrecoverable one (structure-unstable) at most 0.74 even on engine features; 0.75 separates them

rule.guard: fewer than 20 positive or 20 negative frames -> readiness_or_precision_insufficient
rule.label_invalid: engine-feature ceiling below 0.75 -> the label, not the encoder, is at fault

identifiability.split: leave-one-level-out over the cell's fit roster; scored once on its evaluation roster (DESCRIPTIVE)

targets.external-force-active: levels 2, 3, 4, 7, 8 and the level-0 turbulence families
targets.gravity-inverted: level 6 against its paired normal levels

rollout_error.anchor: decision state (native step 30000) of every evaluation level x candidate

conditions.few_shot: per novelty level, encoder and predictors adapted on the novel side of that level's five fit rosters: 2000 updates, batch 64, lr 1e-4, identical for every arm
conditions.zero_shot: encoder and predictors fitted on normal data only: the normal side of every pair's fit split plus the #104 normal fit split

rollout_error.contrast: novel-side error minus paired normal-side error, paired by roster ordinal; DESCRIPTIVE level-clustered percentile bootstrap, 10 000 draws
rollout_error.error: presence-masked carrier MSE against the engine-projected v2 carrier

smoke_gate.failure: a template failing a pass criterion makes its cell unsupported (typed reason) before the campaign freeze; a labeler disagreement is repaired in the derivation before any training
smoke_gate.membership: the smoke roster (1 paired level per pair, both sides) x candidates ['c05', 'c10']
pass_criteria_per_template: zero typed capture failures (#109 taxonomy) and render invariance at the decision seal
every authored slot, including novelty:0000, present in the trace with its authored identity
world gravity (0, 6) on level 6 and (0, -9.8) elsewhere
right-slingshot candidates launch leftward (bird_launched velocity x < 0)
residual acceleration of contact-free bodies agrees in sign with every active force-on label
reported_not_gated: storm onset inside the capture window

screening_rules.order: smoke -> fit -> evaluation; pairs in level-major, scenario-minor order; ascending attempt
screening_rules.pairing: both sides share the generation and engine seed; an attempt is accepted only if both pass
screening_rules.restrictions: workbook distraction restrictions applied (Magnet levels: no wood circle distractions)
rules: any generated slot outside the v2 vocabulary on either side
xml / scenario content or scenario identity equal to an earlier level or a prior exposure
